method: Derived join of exact retained real tcltest PASS/SKIP lines to authored case/result expressions. PASS records only the asserted equality, not unrecorded intermediate values or execution traces. SKIP supplies no oracle answer. Original input, raw transcripts and actual C binary/startup receipts remain separately retained evidence.
